item.name: magnetic-button
item.summary: cta: Magnetic spring wrapper for buttons and links with fine-pointer gating (dom, server-safe, <2.5 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> 0 listeners)

useWhen: High-priority call-to-action buttons in hero and conversion sections
Interactive icon triggers and primary action links
Header navigation actions seeking tactile physical response
avoidWhen: Dense lists of repeating table buttons or compact toolbar grids
Touch-first mobile interfaces with coarse pointer navigation

alternatives.name: text-reveal
alternatives.when: When animating entrance typography rather than interactive hover responses

tiers.0: Static unadorned button without pointer listeners or translation
tiers.1: Static button with zero pointer listeners on coarse touch devices
tiers.2: Gentle magnetic attraction with reduced pull radius (10px)
tiers.3: Full spring physics loop on fine pointer hover with settling to zero rAF

reducedMotion.description: Button retains static position without magnetic cursor tracking.

input.pointer: Cursor attraction with physical spring settling within 0.01px tolerance
input.touch: Zero pointer listeners attached on coarse/touch screens
input.keyboard: Focus snaps button to origin immediately; focus rings remain unclipped

a11y.notes: Preserves native keyboard semantics, focus rings are not clipped by overflow, and keyboard focus immediately resets translation to origin.

props.name: children
props.effect: Interactive element (button or link) wrapped by magnetic controller.

props.name: className
props.effect: Additional CSS classes applied to the outer wrapper.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on device capability tier.

mistakes: Do not set overflow: hidden on MagneticButton or parent containers, or focus rings will be clipped.
Do not wrap non-interactive static text in MagneticButton; reserve for buttons and action links.
verify: Verify button is immediately clickable and focusable in server HTML.
Verify keyboard tabbing triggers focus ring cleanly without clipped edges.
Verify that on touch screens, zero pointer listeners are registered.
